run-name: "OpenCode #${{ github.event.issue.number || inputs.issue_number }}${{ github.event.issue.title && format(' — {0}', github.event.issue.title) || '' }}"

on:
  issues:
    types: [opened]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      issue_number:
        description: Existing issue to run
        required: true
        type: string

permissions: {}

concurrency:
  group: opencode-issue-${{ github.repository }}-${{ github.event.issue.number || inputs.issue_number }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  prepare:
    if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' || (github.event.action == 'opened' && contains(github.event.issue.labels.*.name, 'OpenCode'))
    permissions:
      contents: write
      id-token: write
      issues: write
      actions: write
    uses: denaidark/OhMyGithub/.github/workflows/opencode-prepare.yml@3b460fef6b0cbee61ae301726c8a54b00b73bfd2

  opencode:
    needs: prepare
    if: needs.prepare.outputs.approved == 'true'
    permissions:
      contents: write
      id-token: write
      issues: write

# 🤯 OMG — Oh My GitHub ### 🚀 One Prompt In. A Full Game or App Out. 🚀 [![Status](https://img.shields.io/badge/status-🔥%20works-brightgreen?style=for-the-badge)](https://github.com/denaidark/OhMyGithub/actions) [![GitHub Issues](https://img.shields.io/github/issues/denaidark/OhMyGithub?style=for-the-badge&logo=github)](https://github.com/denaidark/OhMyGithub/issues) [![GitHub Actions](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub%20Actions-automated-2088FF?style=for-the-badge&logo=githubactions&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/denaidark/OhMyGithub/actions) [![OpenCode](https://img.shields.io/badge/powered%20by-OpenCode-111111?style=for-the-badge)](https://opencode.ai/) ```text ╔══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗ ║ DESCRIBE IT → BUILD IT → TEST IT → PLAY IT ║ ║ ║ ║ One GitHub issue. One prompt. A complete project. ║ ╚══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝ ``` **No API keys to configure. No server to maintain. No local setup maze.**
--- ## 🤯 What Is OMG? > **Your GitHub issue becomes the product brief.** OMG (Oh My GitHub) is an automated GitHub Actions workflow for creating complete browser games and app projects from one natural-language prompt. Write what you want in an issue and add the `OpenCode` label. OpenCode checks out the project, uses the shared skills, builds the experience, runs tests, verifies the result, and publishes an immutable OmGithub project link from the finished commit. Yes, it creates the code. Yes, it runs the verification loop. Yes, it can expose the result in a temporary browser URL. ## 🧠 TL;DR 1. Open a GitHub issue. 2. Describe the game or app you want. 3. Add the `OpenCode` label to the issue. 4. Let GitHub Actions build, test, verify, and propose the result. ```text Your idea → GitHub issue → OpenCode → tests → immutable OmGithub project ``` ## ⚡ Quick Start Create an issue in your repository with a concrete request: ```text Build a neon asteroid game. Requirements: - Arrow-key movement - Score and restart button - Win and lose states - Responsive browser layout - Run tests and verify it in a browser ``` That is the whole user-facing workflow. GitHub Actions handles the runner, OpenCode handles implementation, and the workflow handles verification plus the immutable project commit. To run against an existing non-default branch, end the issue title with a `branch: ` directive. The directive selects the checkout and is removed before the issue body is sent to OpenCode: ```sh gh issue create \ --repo denaidark/OhMyGithub \ --title "Custom branch smoke test branch: codex/omgithub-site" \ --body "Build a tiny browser page." \ --label Goal \ --label OpenCode ``` The GitHub App validates the branch before dispatching. ## Objective
- Build a complete, polished 2D action platformer "SHADOW STRIKE: CYBER RONIN" in the empty repo, then test and fix it in a real browser.

## Requirements
- Beautiful neon cyberpunk city with parallax backgrounds.
- Responsive movement/jumping/double-jumping/dashing and katana combat.
- Three enemy types with distinct attack patterns and a multi-phase boss.
- Katana combo system and dash attack.
- Collectible energy orbs and score.
- Health/energy bars, enemy health indicators.
- Checkpoints and progressive difficulty.
- Particles, glowing attacks, screen shake, hit feedback.
- Main menu, pause, victory, game-over screens.
- Mobile touch controls and keyboard support.
- Self-contained, no unnecessary external dependencies; actual playable mechanics; stable performance; clean code; premium indie feel.
- Must test every mechanic and fix errors before declaring complete.

## Decisions
- Use a self-contained HTML5 Canvas 2D game with ES modules and no external libraries/assets; all art and audio are procedural.
- Fixed logical resolution 1280×720, responsive CSS scaling, landscape-first with portrait rotate overlay.
- Web Audio API synthesized SFX and ambient music.
- DOM overlays for menus/HUD; canvas for gameplay.
- One continuous ~12,200px level with 4 sectors, checkpoints, and boss arena.
- Three enemies: diving Drone, lunging MeleeBot, shooting Gunner; boss "Overlord Zero" with 3 phases and several attacks.
- Debug/test API exposed at `window.__SHADOW__`.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created full project structure and all game systems: `index.html`, `style.css`, `src/main.js`, `game.js`, `player.js`, `enemies.js`, `boss.js`, `level.js`, `particles.js`, `audio.js`, `input.js`, `ui.js`, `util.js`.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a complete, polished 2D action platformer "SHADOW STRIKE: CYBER RONIN" in the repo, then test and fix it in a real browser.

## Requirements
- Beautiful neon cyberpunk city with parallax backgrounds; responsive movement/jumping/double-jumping/dashing and katana combat.
- Three enemy types with distinct attack patterns and a multi-phase boss; katana combo system and dash attack.
- Collectible energy orbs and score; health/energy bars; enemy health indicators.
- Checkpoints and progressive difficulty; particles, glowing attacks, screen shake, hit feedback.
- Main menu, pause, victory, game-over screens; mobile touch controls and keyboard support.
- Self-contained, no unnecessary external dependencies; actual playable mechanics; stable performance; clean code; premium indie feel.
- Must test every mechanic and fix errors before declaring complete.

## Decisions
- Self-contained HTML5 Canvas 2D game with ES modules; no external libraries/assets; all art/audio procedural.
- Fixed logical resolution 1280×720, responsive CSS scaling, landscape-first with portrait rotate overlay.
- Web Audio API synthesized SFX/music; DOM overlays for menus/HUD; canvas for gameplay.
- One continuous ~12,200px level with 4 sectors, checkpoints, and boss arena.
- Three enemies: diving Drone, lunging MeleeBot, shooting Gunner; boss "Overlord Zero" with 3 phases.
- Debug/test API exposed at `window.__SHADOW__`.

## Work State
### Completed
- Full project structure and all game systems implemented: `index.html`, `style.css`, `src/main.js`, `game.js`, `player.js`, `enemies.js`, `boss.js`, `level.js`, `particles.js`, `audio.js`, `input.js`, `ui.js`, `util.js`.
- Movement, coyote time, jump buffering, double jump, dash with i-frames, 3-hit combo, air attack, dash strike, energy/health, damage, hitstop, shake, particles, floating text, orbs, score/combo, checkpoints, zone progression, boss phases, victory/game-over, pause, menus, touch controls, synthesized audio.
- Axis-separated collision fixed in `Player.resolveHorizontal/resolveVertical` and `Enemy.physics`.
- Rich city background rewrite completed and verified: far/mid/street/near/foreground parallax layers, signs, windows, lanterns.
- Menu fixed: brightened screen overlay/`menu-bg`, footer made static below actions, sound button no longer overlaps key hints.
- Ground rendering upgraded: wet asphalt, curb, reflections, puddles, lane markings, panel seams, grates, animated sheen, bloom; bottom haze reduced.
- Player readability improved: 1.14× draw scale, energy backlight aura, cyan forward rim, helmet rim, boot sole glow.
- Boss HUD moved to top (`top: 0.9%`, width `min(60%,760px)`) so it no longer overlaps player HUD; `#hud.boss-fight` class shifts player HUD down on coarse pointers.
- Boss arena camera now frames both duelists via `Game.cameraTarget()`; boss spawn moved to `11400`; arena trigger moved to `10650` (solid ground).
- Fixed `Game.teleport()` debug path and `gotoBoss()` now teleports to `10680, 620 - player.h`.
- Fixed missing hazard damage: added `Game.handleHazards()` (called from update); lasers now damage player.
- Fixed `this.ui?.showToast is not a function` in `retryCheckpoint` → `this.ui?.toast`.
- Debug API `gotoBoss` bug (nonexistent `game.teleport`) resolved by adding the method.
- Touch controls container now matches game aspect area; mobile HUD buttons moved to top-right vertical stack; `hud-zone` hidden on coarse pointers; joystick label spacing improved.
- Verified: menu/boot, movement, jump/double jump, attack/combo, dash energy cost, dash i-frames, dash strike (via controlled state), parry, orb collection, enemy kills for melee/gunner/drone paths, checkpoints, pause/resume, game over/retry/fall death, menu restart, all 4 zone transitions, moving platform carry, hazards, mobile joystick/buttons, portrait overlay, boss trigger/intro/3 phases/attacks/damage/death/victory, no page errors in final runs.

### Active
- Final polish/verification pass; latest boss hit screenshot shows boss fight and HUD working.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Re-run final syntax check and a broad browser console error scan after last CSS/UI edits.
2. Take final screenshots of menu, gameplay, boss fight, victory, and mobile to confirm no regressions.
3. Update `README.md` with game description, controls, and how to run.
4. Review remaining polish: optional suppression of parallax "OPEN" sign behind boss head; confirm mobile boss HUD placement with new `#hud.boss-fight` shift.
5. Verify git status and leave repo in a clean, runnable state (changes uncommitted unless user requests commit).

## Relevant Files
- `src/game.js`: loop, combat/projectile/hazard resolution, scoring, checkpoints, arena camera, boss trigger, rendering orchestration, `teleport`/`cameraTarget`, debug stats.
- `src/player.js`: movement, attacks, dash/dash-strike, collision, procedural character art.
- `src/enemies.js`: Drone/MeleeBot/Gunner AI, `Bolt` projectiles, physics/art.
- `src/boss.js`: Overlord Zero states, phased attacks, laser/shockwaves, boss art.
- `src/level.js`: world geometry, enemy/orb/checkpoint data, procedural background, wet-street/platform/hazard/orb rendering.
- `src/ui.js`: HUD/menu/screen/toast/hint/DOM management, boss HUD class toggling, `hideSector`.
- `src/main.js`: bootstrap, event wiring, fixed timestep, `window.__SHADOW__` debug API.
- `src/input.js`: keyboard, mouse, virtual joystick, touch action buttons.
- `src/audio.js`: synthesized Web Audio SFX/music.
- `src/particles.js`: particles, rings, floating text.
- `style.css`: full UI styling; menu, boss HUD, touch-control positioning, mobile media queries.

- `World.getZone`/`Background.paletteFor` support zone blending; use `background.paletteFor(x)`.
- Boss phases trigger at ≤66% HP (phase 2) and ≤33% HP (phase 3); boss is invulnerable during `intro`/`phase`/`dying`.
- All repo changes are uncommitted; git status shows infrastructure files and game files as untracked.
